decision: ACCEPT bounded causes for frozen26 sparse deltas; raw FAIL and approval boundary unchanged
scope: Independent offline source/data checks of all 225 unadmitted pre-render IR leaves and the one unadmitted native-fact leaf, against exact saved ordinary/sparse artifacts. Not a whole-unit or output-bless verdict.
findings: All 225 raw IR paths are accounted for exactly once: 97 census leaves, 122 checkpoint projection-obligation leaves, three activation provenance/hash leaves, and three hidden-size chip/address fields. Raw values and before/after presence match the actual saved IR at every path.

Each of the six census lists is sorted and duplicate-free. Only hidden_act, hidden_size and num_attention_heads change between checkpoint occurrence census and absent-default census. Retained entries preserve their relative order; no arbitrary set conversion concealed duplicate removal or reorder.

Projection-obligation identities are unique in both conditions and retain exact relative order. Of 22 old rows, four omitted-checkpoint rows are absent, 15 are identical, and three differ only in expected_value_status_hash, which matches the exact final native fact in each condition. No added row and no retained state/reason/target/source/mechanism change.

Each of the four removed checkpoint obligations has exactly one saved sparse absent_default counterpart with matching path/target/mechanism, class_default provenance, exact path, and final fact hash. ConfigAccessLedger.projection_obligations enumerates consumed checkpoint occurrences only; this is a domain change due to actual omission, not a declaration that those mechanisms became proven.

All 25 native fact keys, values, kinds, completeness and unknown reasons remain equal; no existing semantic proof becomes missing. Activation remains applied_function/uninspected/null proof in both conditions. Its code_and_config to class_default tier explains the single unadmitted fact leaf and three transported IR leaves, without qualifying application.

The embedding block differs only by presentation_chips, presentation_aliases and presentation_path. It gains exactly one class_default hidden_size:4096 chip whose reference equals the saved qualified hidden-size VALUE fact reference byte-for-byte under JSON equality; all existing block fields are identical.
limitations: Semantic rekeying is used only for explanatory comparison here; no original artifact, ordering or raw delta was rewritten.

Removed checkpoint projection rows remain explicit in checks.json alongside their default-event counterparts. This does not establish default projection receipt completeness or close stronger application proof debt.
The existing 48 admitted IR leaves are not being re-approved by this 225-leaf cause verdict. Prior source/default-proof reviews and capture validation remain their separate authority.
No product import, model execution, renderer run or browser review by this reviewer. No matrix acceptance, preservation bless, output renewal or S9-A completion.
Keep raw sparse FAIL. Cause accounting and successful event association are separate from qualified mechanism completeness and Soumil output approval.
